comparison.objective: Remove a spray-can cap, coat a plaque with limited overspray, and finish with the can safely held; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Cap extraction, can grasping, nozzle actuation, and controlled raster spraying.
comparison.success_condition: Scores cap parking, paint coverage, overspray, can posture, button release, contact, and dwell; candidate scores retained mechanical adjustment.
comparison.reason: Spray deposition and overspray control share no meaningful tested mechanism with gripper-stop locking.
